description: Refresh clips' media from disk (Refresh Media), take them offline keeping the files (Clip > Make Offline, one undo step), or attach a proxy or the full-resolution file to one clip (Proxy > Attach Proxies, Reconnect Full Resolution Media; not undoable)

items.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

mediaPath.description: With attach_proxy or attach_full_resolution: absolute path of the proxy or full-resolution file

selected.description: Also act on the items selected in the Project panel

name: manage_media
title: Manage Media
